items.description: Hidden Shelter is a first-person horror game, focused on exploration, developed by the White Vortex studio. It is under development on the Unreal Engine for Windows PC. Explore the area in search of clues and escape from a bloodthirsty being who wants to kill all those who approach the place.The game's story is about three friends who after a sudden white flash on the road got into an accident. Their car crashed. After waking up, Charles and Bernard lose sight of Diego. Diego is Bernard's older brother and friend of Charles who drove the car. Desperate with the strange noise in the woods, Charles decides to go out for help, even though he doesn't believe that Diego was still alive. Bernard, on the other hand, does not want to leave his brother behind and believes that he managed to escape. The two leave for a mansion in the forest in search of their lost friend and at the same time need to stay alive by running away from a sinister creature that inhabits the place.Something unusual happened in that house that resonates around the place as a kind of eternal curse. Bad things happened there. Love has always been blamed for everything.It is up to the player to put the pieces of this dark puzzle together and find out what is the thread that unites the accident, the strange creature, murders and the history of the house itself. items.description: You just lost your job and you're ready to live a little before getting back to work.In this third game to the "Bad Dog" Series you'll embark (bark!), no pun intended, on a fun adventure for the next few weeks in-between jobs. Go out on dinner dates, meet new friends, and make love in this new feature packed adventure.Explore different locations, ask Banjo out on different excursions and explore new mini-games in this addition to the series. You have access to the world in your hands.... uhhh, urrrr.. paws! Sure lounging around is fun and all but you could also get laid while you're at it!This jam-packed adventure is story oriented with day one and two out at release and more coming with future free updates which each have their unique opportunities for adventures with Banjo and others. The primary game-play is point and click, however there are mini-games throughout different areas which may differ into different game styles such as retro game-play.Enjoy your time off work! items.description: 🔥 Sinister Outbreak – You woke up in a nightmare. Now fight your way out.You wake up in a dark, deserted laboratory... and it's far too quiet. There's no memory of what happened — just blood on the walls and the sound of something approaching. Something that is no longer alive.Welcome to Sinister Outbreak, an action-packed game set in a chilling atmosphere of horror and survival.🧟‍♂️ Survive the unexpectedExplore dark corridors and abandoned rooms, where every corner may hide unspeakable horrors. Armed only with what you can find, you’ll face brutal zombies and out-of-control experiments as you search for answers — and a way out.🔫 Intense action with a touch of horrorBlending combat with moments of pure tension, Sinister Outbreak puts your reflexes to the test. Manage your ammo, solve puzzles, and try to make it out alive. Not everything can be faced head-on. items.description: Rest House is first person adventure based on the same name feature movie. Description: “all Wrong.”Game consists of five stories that are connected with mysterious characters and events.The main character is trying to discover the meaning each of them. He gets sucked in the events that will lead him to the strange places where he meets strange people, fairy tale creatures and landscapes.There are currently 6 levels in the game. Player is in the role of the single character who is trying to find the way out from each of the levels. At the end there is a special gift waiting. Key features of the game: Story which is based on the short famous novels by Dino Buzzati, Edgar Alan Poe and others... Interesting art style inspired by the surreal art and literature. Rest house is challenging for the player. Puzzles and hidden keys are sometimes hard to solve and find. Be part of the RH community. Viewers are taking part in the game development. They are suggesting the game features and commenting on the game play. Creator is live streaming almost every day and communicating with the players so they are constantly immersed in the Rest House world.Early Access-Game Is Not Complete and Will Change further. We are working on multiplayer, HTML5 and VR versions of the levels which you can check at our site.Rest House-movie-Feature that contains many insights and secrets witch you can unlock in the game.Important! items.description: Gold for Retirement - is a hardcore platformer that will challenge you and push your skills to the limit! Embark on an exciting adventure where every gold coin brings you one step closer to a carefree retirement. Explore dozens of levels filled with tough challenges and dangerous traps.Enjoy stylish pixel art that immerses you in the atmosphere of classic platformers, and lose yourself in the game’s world thanks to its incredible soundtrack. But the main highlight - is the unique flying mechanic! Your knight is equipped with a special device built into their helmet, allowing them to soar, glide, and overcome even the most difficult obstacles.You are a knight, albeit not so young as you once were, but your heart is still full of nobility and your sword is still sharpened to a fine point. Every time you put on your armour, you experience a familiar thrill - your past is full of heroic deeds and adventures, and new quests await you in the future. You have rescued beauties out of the paws of terrible dragons, fought mighty beasts, and even faced small but cunning monsters.But behind these exploits lies one big truth: gold. Yes, gold! It gleams brightly in the sun, and every coin sound delights your ear. Who else would think of a carefree old age if not you? Which banner or medal would help you rest easy in the decline of your years? Your old legends? Or that humble fee the kingdom ordered to pay you for your hazardous adventures? Alas, neither can provide you with a peaceful old age.Meanwhile, your knighthood privileges are beginning to crack like the armour that has served you for more than a decade. Your purpose is clear: it's time to hit the road, to take enough gold with you to end your days in luxury and comfort. This year will be a year of good fortune - you are about to set out on an exciting journey, where the sword will be drawn only for defence, and the search for wealth will become your primary mission in life. items.description: Do what the voice tells you, no matter how wrong it feels.You open your eyes to a bare room. No windows. No doors. No escape. Complete each daily task.Only a bed, a table, a bathroom, and a voice that speaks when you wake. Each morning, it gives you a task. At first, they seem harmless—simple chores in a place that shouldn’t exist. But by the second day, the tone shifts. The tasks grow darker, more personal, more invasive. You begin to wonder what the voice wants from you—or if it wants you to become something else. How far will you go to survive when there’s no way out?The only rule: obey the voice for seven days.
